pickup_help:
[E] Pick up spike box  
[G] Take fob
box_missing: The linked spike box no longer exists
box_busy: The spike box is still moving
fob_not_linked: This fob is not linked to a spike box
fob_out_of_range: The spike box is out of range
fob_no_boxes: No spike boxes are linked to you
not_authorized: You are not allowed to do that
not_owner: This spike box is not yours
in_vehicle: You cannot do that from a vehicle
too_many_boxes: Too many spike boxes are placed
too_many_own_boxes: You already have the maximum number of spike boxes placed
no_item: You do not have the required item
fob_taken: Fob taken, it is linked to this box
fob_limit: No more fobs can be issued for this box
fob_already: You already have a fob for this box
